effort.label: Effort
effort.hint: How much thinking Claude Code puts into each turn. Empty uses the CLI's own default.

permissionMode.label: Permission mode
permissionMode.hint: Applies to code-producing sessions (build, ticket build, team build). Reviews, grading and every read-only session keep the posture their tool channel needs.

reasoningEffort.label: Reasoning effort
reasoningEffort.hint: Codex's reasoning budget. Empty uses the model's own default.

profile.label: Config profile
profile.hint: Layers $CODEX_HOME/'<name>'.config.toml over the base config. Empty uses no profile.

thinking.label: Thinking
thinking.hint: Oh My Pi's thinking level. Empty uses the CLI's own default.

maxTime.label: Time limit (seconds)
maxTime.hint: Stops the session after this many seconds. Empty lets Arij's watchdog own the timing.

advisor.label: Advisor
advisor.hint: Runs Oh My Pi's advisor, which passively reviews each turn and injects notes.

effort.label: Reasoning effort
effort.hint: Antigravity's reasoning effort. Empty uses the CLI's own default.
